fields.description: Master switch. When off, the webhook endpoint rejects events and the outbound client refuses to send.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Base URL of the RandomPack backend, e.g. https://ops.randompack.com
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: API key of the backend's Friday Integration user (token auth: key + secret).
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: API secret — stored encrypted at rest, never in code or git.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: Shared HMAC secret for inbound webhook signatures (X-RP-Signature). Stored encrypted at rest. One per environment.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Reject signatures whose per-attempt timestamp `t` is older/newer than this many seconds (design 60: Stripe-style signing; backend re-signs replays with fresh t).
fields.label: Signature Tolerance (seconds)
